bof.f: Initialism of birds of a feather (“group of people with common interests”).

s.g: (chiefly Internet, humorous, typically considered vulgar) An interjection of "both of my balls" or "both of deez nuts".
s.x: "Hey, do you know what bofa is?" "What's bofa?" "Bofa deez nuts in your mouth!"

s.g: (entertainment, slang) A line in a film etc that elicits such a laugh.
(entertainment, slang) A great success; a hit.
(slang, derogatory) A pupil who works hard; a swot.
(Australia, New Zealand, UK, Ireland, informal) An engineer or scientist, especially one engaged in technological or military research.
(Australia, New Zealand, UK, Ireland, informal, by extension) A person with specialized knowledge or skills, especially one who is socially awkward.
(chiefly US, slang) Outstanding; very good or successful.
(chiefly in the world of entertainment) A great success; a hit.
